subject: Private offer checklist & billing routing for Lyra Systems - next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lyra-systems.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up — private offer request and procurement path

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the latency numbers and the cost controls look promising. Procurement asked me to get a formal mutual action plan (MAP) so they can slot vendor onboarding into our June procurement window. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a short MAP that lists milestones, owner names, and target dates for (1) private offer issuance on AWS Marketplace, (2) contract signature, and (3) billing/invoicing cadence?
- What billing paths do you support? Ideally we want to buy via AWS Private Offer and have charges flow to our consolidated billing account. Procurement also asked whether Redwood can accept NET45 invoices for the initial term.

We aim to finalize budget approval by 2027-06-30 and would like an optimistic close by 2027-07-12 if the private offer and legal review go smoothly. Can you send a short checklist and attach the private-offer request template so our procurement team can begin the paperwork?

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Integrations
Lyra Systems
sofia.ramos@lyra-systems.com
+1 415 555 0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lyra-systems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — private offer request and procurement path

Hi Sofia — great to hear this is moving. Attached are two items to get procurement started: lyra_map_v1.xlsx (a short MAP with milestones/owners/dates) and a private-offer request PDF that we submit to AWS Marketplace ops. High level responses inline below.

Quick answers:
- MAP: see attached. Proposed milestones:
  • 2027-06-21: Redwood sends private offer request to AWS (owner: Rishi)
  • 2027-06-24: AWS confirms private offer draft & Lyra signs PO (owner: Lyra procurement)
  • 2027-06-27: Legal executes Redwood master services agreement (owner: Marissa)
  • 2027-07-01: Private offer activated and billing route verified (owner: Ben)
  • 2027-07-12: Go-live / first invoice period starts (owner: Lyra engineering)

- Billing paths: We support AWS Private Offer (charges flow through Lyra consolidated billing), Invoice via Redwood (NET30 default), and platform partner billing (special cases).

- NET45: Our standard is NET30. We can escalate a NET45 request to Sales Director for approval; in practice we approve a small number of NET45 requests on enterprise deals when CFO sign-off is provided. If you need NET45, please have procurement include the request in the PO submission and we'll loop Marissa/Finance.

Next steps for us: Ben, can you prepare the AWS Marketplace private-offer payload and confirm the billing ARN we should use? Marissa, please flag any legal items in the attached MSA template. Sofia — if procurement can provide the account billing ARN and PO template today we can push the private offer to AWS tomorrow.

Attachments: lyra_map_v1.xlsx (MAP 1-pager), lyra_private_offer_request.pdf (AWS payload template)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com

Date: 2027-06-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Lyra private-offer build & billing verification (urgent)

Ben / Marissa — quick internal checklist to get Lyra across the line this week. Lyra is on a tight budget timeline (approval 6/30). Please treat as high priority.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Ben: Build private-offer draft in AWS Marketplace console. Use SKU: LYRA-ENT-001 and proposed list price from HubSpot opp (link below). Need billing ARN for Lyra consolidated account (ask procurement). ETA: 2027-06-21 EOD.
- Ben: Confirm whether we can set billing to "Charge to buyer's AWS account" so charges show under Lyra consolidated billing. If not, note fallback options. ETA: 2027-06-21.
- Marissa: Review the attached MSA + highlight any CLIN/T&Cs that procurement will push back on (data residency, audit rights, indemnity). ETA: 2027-06-24.
- Monica (Finance): Pre-approve NET45 escalation path — if Lyra requests NET45, what approvals are required? Provide list of approvers. ETA: 2027-06-21.
- Rishi: Coordinate PO template back to Lyra and update MAP after AWS confirmation. ETA: 2027-06-22.

Related artifacts: https://salesforce.redwood.example.com/opp/RY-3421 (Salesforce opp) | https://hubspot.example.com/engagements/HS-9082

Ben — I pasted the AWS Marketplace private offer doc stub into the ticket in case you need it. If you hit any roadblocks with billing ARNs or tax keys, escalate to Marketplace ops (cc: marketplace-ops@redwood.example.com from your console).

Thanks — Rishi

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lyra-systems.com>

Cc: procurement@lyra-systems.com
Date: 2027-06-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer checklist & billing routing for Lyra Systems - next steps

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the MAP. Procurement confirmed they can provide the billing ARN by EOD 6/21 and will attach the PO template. A couple of follow-ups:

- Invoicing cadence: our finance team prefers monthly invoices and would like to know if Redwood can emit a consolidated invoice for charges billed through AWS Marketplace (we can accept either AWS invoices or Redwood invoices that reconcile to AWS usage).
- NET45: procurement will formally request NET45 on the PO. If you can start the approval flow now with Finance, that will help speed things — otherwise it may push us outside the June budget window.
- EDI / PO fields: our procurement system requires an explicit PO number and a remit-to address on the invoice (we can include both in the PO). Please confirm Redwood's remit-to and tax ID and whether you need an EDI document for automated ingestion.

If you can confirm the above by EOD 6/22 we'll move to submit the private-offer request to AWS on 6/23.

Best,
Sofia
